verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe crawling an entire site in one request (up to 500 pages synchronously, or 25,000 pages via async batch) returning Markdown/HTML, plus a case study of SiteGPT using Context.dev to scrape entire websites for a knowledge base. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of crawl completeness/reliability at scale and clarity on handling of dynamic/JS-heavy sites during crawl.
